title: Minecraft BEST Slime Farm Tutorial - FASTER & EASY - 20,000 P/HR!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make a Super Ultra Faster Slime Farm that is only based 2 3 simple things such as dirt blocks and an iron golem In Minecraft 

📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +4,000 Up To 20,000 Slime Balls Per Hour!  ( Depends on the number of layers )
📚This farm works in swamp lakes
📚This farm is using a new box design that will make the farm work at 100% efficiency
📚This farm will work on the servers too
📚You can build this farm only on the Java edition!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
